scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace client" "npm run dev --workspace server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace shared && npm run typecheck --workspace client && npm run typecheck --workspace server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace client && npm run test --workspace server
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace client && npm run test:coverage --workspace server
scripts.test:api: newman run postman/CSE-416-API.postman_collection.json --env-var baseUrl=http://127.0.0.1:3000 --reporters cli && newman run postman/CSE-416-Settlements.postman_collection.json --env-var baseUrl=http://127.0.0.1:3000 --reporters cli
scripts.test:api:ci: start-server-and-test 'npm run start --workspace server' http-get://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health 'npm run test:api'
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build --workspace client && cap sync ios
scripts.mobile:run: npm run mobile:sync && cap run ios
